title: Read the PCB viewport title and a technology set licence
summary: Gets DXP.IServerSecurity from a server module to check whether a technology set is licensed, then reads IPCB_Board.Viewport and its title, handling the null viewport an ordinary board returns.
phrasings: check if a technology set is licensed
read the viewport of a board
is a feature licensed in this session
